description: This file defines a Blazor component code-behind class 'List' for managing catalog items, including listing, viewing details, creating, editing, and deleting catalog items in a web admin interface.

classes.name: List
classes.description: Code-behind class for the Catalog Item listing page, managing catalog items, types, and brands, and handling user interactions such as view details, create, edit, delete.

methods.name: OnAfterRenderAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to load catalog data asynchronously after the component's first render.

methods.name: DetailsClick
methods.description: Handles click event to show details of a catalog item.

methods.name: CreateClick
methods.description: Handles click event to initiate creation of a new catalog item.

methods.name: EditClick
methods.description: Handles click event to initiate editing of a catalog item.

methods.name: DeleteClick
methods.description: Handles click event to delete a catalog item.

methods.name: ReloadCatalogItems
methods.description: Reloads catalog items list and updates the UI.
